package.name: arm_lab_kinematics
package.description: Kinematics test bench for the rover arm: full 6-DOF inverse kinematics, reachable and dexterous workspace mapping, singularity analysis, capsule self-collision checking, Cartesian straight-line motion with a real TCP speed limit, time-optimal trajectory timing under torque limits, ISO 9283 accuracy and repeatability testing with error injection, and MoveIt 2 configuration generation.
